text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Kuwaiti press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah discusses bilateral relations with the visiting president of the Comoros.
- Interior ministry says prison hunger strike is over. About 600 inmates started a hunger strike on Saturday to demand better living conditions and less restriction in the prison's visiting area.
- Cabinet source says parliamentary elections set for October 7.
- Kuwait Investment Projects Company reports 202 percent rise in its mid-year results.

- Parliament to discuss report on defence ministry supply contracts. Parliament earlier this month gave its public funds protection committee investigatory powers to probe alleged irregularities in defence ministry contracts.
- Commerce official says Kuwaiti laws need to be amended to be in line with the regulations of World Trade Organisation.
